import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette for fraud vs non-fraud
fraud_palette = {0: '#2ecc71', 1: '#e74c3c'}
fraud_labels = {0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'}

# 1. Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for fraud_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['is_fraud'] == fraud_status]['amount']
    ax1.hist(subset, bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=fraud_labels[fraud_status], 
             color=fraud_palette[fraud_status], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Status')

# 2. Fraud Count by Transaction Type
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=[fraud_palette[0], fraud_palette[1]], 
                   edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Count by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Status')

# 3. Hourly Distribution of Fraud vs Non-Fraud Transactions
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby(['hour_of_day', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
hourly_fraud[0].plot(ax=ax3, marker='o', color=fraud_palette[0], label='Legitimate', linewidth=2)
hourly_fraud[1].plot(ax=ax3, marker='s', color=fraud_palette[1], label='Fraud', linewidth=2)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Patterns Throughout the Day', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.legend(title='Status')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Box Plot of Transaction Amounts by Type and Fraud Status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map(fraud_labels)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_label',
            palette={'Legitimate': fraud_palette[0], 'Fraud': fraud_palette[1]}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Status')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# Add overall statistics as text
total_transactions = len(df)
fraud_count = df['is_fraud'].sum()
fraud_rate = (fraud_count / total_transactions) * 100
avg_fraud_amount = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'].mean()
avg_legit_amount = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'].mean()

stats_text = f'Total Transactions: {total_transactions:,}\nFraud Rate: {fraud_rate:.1f}%\nAvg Fraud Amount: ${avg_fraud_amount:.2f}\nAvg Legit Amount: ${avg_legit_amount:.2f}'
fig.text(0.02, 0.02, stats_text, fontsize=10, verticalalignment='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.93, bottom=0.12)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
